extracted_information: Kaspersky EDR maps its findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to provide detailed information on cybercriminal Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs). Both Kaspersky EDR's Sandbox technology and Targeted Attack Analyzer map their results to MITRE ATT&CK. The Sandbox analyzes threat activity in a safe environment, and if malicious, maps suspicious activities to the ATT&CK knowledgebase. The Targeted Attack Analyzer discovers suspicious actions based on enhanced anomaly heuristics and correlates them with Indicators of Attack (IoAs) generated by Kaspersky's Threat Hunters. These IoAs are also mapped to MITRE ATT&CK to provide detailed information including the technique used, description, and mitigation strategies.

features.name: Kaspersky EDR Mapping to MITRE ATT&CK

features.name: Targeted Attack Analyzer
features.description: Discovers suspicious actions using enhanced anomaly heuristics and correlates events with Indicators of Attack (IoAs) for automated real-time threat hunting.
ioa_tpp_based_detection_supports: Apparently suspicious functionality in legitimate utilities where classification may require human intervention
Tools used by attackers that are not explicitly malicious but their hostile usage is

features.name: Indicators of Attack (IoAs)
features.description: Generated by Kaspersky's Threat Hunters, used for detecting anomalies. Automatically updated database. Users can create custom IoAs.
features.mapping: All IoAs are mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, providing detailed information including ATT&CK-defined technique, description, and mitigation strategies. This enriches incident events with MITRE knowledgebase context.

File upload with BITS (Background Intelligent Transfer Service)
Use of command 'whoami' from SYSTEM account

features.name: Proactive Threat Hunting
features.description: Allows analysts to build complex queries using a query builder to search for atypical behavior, suspicious events, and threats specific to their infrastructure. Supports searching against individual ATT&CK techniques.
capabilities: Earlier and more accurate detection of cybercrime activities
Finding suspicious events even if their severity is not high (alerts not raised by product)

features.name: Threat Discovery Methods (Kaspersky EDR)
features.description: Applies multiple methods and technologies for threat discovery and enriches results with MITRE ATT&CK data.
